name: Reverse osmosis (RO), electrodeionisation (EDI/CEDI) and demineralisation for boiler make-up; conductivity/sil
description: Produce high-purity make-up water with very low dissolved solids, silica and CO2 to allow high cycles of concentration, low blowdown and safe operation of high-pressure drums and superheaters. RO is the main corrective pre-treatment after softening; EDI/CEDI polishes RO permeate without acid/caustic regenerants. Primary source: https://cea.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/CEA-BG04.pdf
